headline: Local AI engineered for control, speed, and measurable ROI
intro: We help mid-sized companies and technical teams design, deploy, and master privacy-first AI systems. From local RAG and MCP infrastructure to agentic workflows and hands-on workshops.

pillars.title: Local RAG & MCP Infrastructure
pillars.lead: Turn internal documents, databases, and tools into an auditable intelligence layer that never leaves your network.
pillars.description: We architect end-to-end Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) pipelines and Model Context Protocol (MCP) servers tailored to your data sources and hardware budget. Every query, embedding, and model call stays on infrastructure you control.
deliverables: Custom RAG architecture, document parsing, chunking, and hybrid retrieval
MCP server design and deployment connecting local LLMs to internal APIs and files
Hardware sizing, quantization, and inference tuning for workstations or on-prem servers
Zero-cloud-leakage security posture with reproducible model versions
pillars.outcome: Regulated teams, confidential knowledge bases, and predictable high-volume workloads.

pillars.title: Agents, Embeddings & Model Operations
pillars.lead: Move beyond brittle single-shot prompts to reliable, tool-using workflows that ship into daily operations.
pillars.description: We engineer structured prompt loops, custom agent skills, and embedding pipelines across open-source and hybrid models by optimizing accuracy, latency, and token economics without vendor lock-in.
deliverables: Prompt and loop engineering with deterministic validation and evaluation
Agentic workflow, skill, and tool implementation for real business processes
Model benchmarking, selection, and deployment (local & cloud)
Latency, throughput, and cost optimization across LLMs and embeddings
pillars.outcome: Product and engineering teams automating multi-step analysis, triage, and reporting.

pillars.title: Strategic Advisory & Workshops
pillars.lead: Practical, jargon-free guidance that takes your team from first prototype to confident production ownership.
pillars.description: Whether you need a focused online workshop or an end-to-end workflow transformation, we equip SMEs and freelancers with the skills, architecture blueprints, and hardware guidance to own their AI stack.
deliverables: Hands-on workshops and masterclasses on prompt engineering and loop optimization
Guided implementation of agentic workflows, skills, and developer tooling
Competent hardware selection, deployment, and maintenance roadmaps
Token, cost, and build-vs-buy strategy aligned with realistic budgets
pillars.outcome: SMEs, leadership teams, and developers building internal AI capability fast.

processHeadline: From workshop to production in four clear steps

steps.title: Discovery & Audit
steps.text: Map high-value workflows, data sensitivity boundaries, and existing hardware constraints.

steps.title: Prototype & Benchmark
steps.text: Validate retrieval quality, model latency, and accuracy on your real documents.

steps.title: On-Prem Deployment
steps.text: Harden, containerize, and integrate RAG, MCP servers, and agent loops into your stack.

steps.title: Enablement & Handover
steps.text: Train your team with playbooks and workshops so you stay independent long-term.

ctaHeadline: Ready to build AI you actually control?
ctaText: Tell us about your workflows, data constraints, or workshop goals and we will outline a pragmatic path forward.
